newsitem.title: UK: Wesleyan buys Clerical Medical direct sales.
newsitem.headline: Wesleyan buys Clerical Medical direct sales.

text.p: Clerical Medical Investment Group, part of the Halifax Group, has sold its ProVision direct sales arm to mutually-owned Wesleyan Financial Services as an ongoing operation for an undisclosed sum.
Clerical Medcal said the sale would allow it to concentrate on its independent financial adviser (IFA) activities while Wesleyan will contonue to focus on direct sales.
Clerical Medical said ProVision's current customers' products and contracts will be unaffected by the sale.
ProVision is a specialist financial planning service which was one of the first to employ a salaried sales force.
All of ProVision's staff will remain but its headquarters will move from Bristol to join Wesleyan in Birmingham. A small number of redundancies is expected among the 250 staff ProVision employs.
Clerical Medical has around 15 billion stg under management and became a member of the Halifax group last year. It sells investment, pensions and life assurance products.
